# Commands

<!-- Generated by `weir reference`. Do not edit: change the help text in src/main.rs and regenerate. -->

Every command, with the page that describes it.

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`weir auth`](auth.md) | Manage the accounts weir signs in to providers with |
| [`weir track`](track.md) | Start mirroring an owner (an org or a user) or a single repository |
| [`weir untrack`](untrack.md) | Stop mirroring an owner or repository; its mirrors stay on disk |
| [`weir sync`](sync.md) | Bring every mirror in line with its provider |
| [`weir prune`](prune.md) | Delete mirrors that are no longer tracked or are gone from the provider |
| [`weir doctor`](doctor.md) | Explain the git repositories under the root that weir does not manage |
| [`weir status`](status.md) | Show accounts, what is tracked, the last sync and mirrors needing attention |
| [`weir list`](list.md) | List mirrored repositories, one per line |
| [`weir path`](path.md) | Print the path of a repository's mirror |
| [`weir log`](log.md) | Show past sync runs and what each one changed |
| [`weir watch`](watch.md) | Follow a sync that is running, from any terminal |
| [`weir daemon`](daemon.md) | Keep every mirror current: sync, wait, repeat, until stopped |
| [`weir service`](service.md) | Run the daemon as a service that starts at login (with Homebrew, use `brew services`) |
| [`weir provider`](provider.md) | Manage provider hosts (only needed for self-hosted providers) |
| [`weir config`](config.md) | Read or change settings |
| [`weir version`](version.md) | Print the version |

## Options every command accepts

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--json` | Machine-readable output, where the command has any |
| `-q`, `--quiet` | Print errors only |
| `-h`, `--help` | Explain the command |

## Exit codes

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `0` | Everything is in order |
| `1` | It ran, and something needs attention (a repository failed or was skipped, an account was rejected, syncs are stale) |
| `2` | It could not run (bad arguments, nothing tracked, a database error) |
